title: Tell Me What To Learn: Generalizing Neural Memory to be Controllable in Natural Language
abstract: arXiv:2602.23201v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern machine learning models are deployed in diverse, non-stationary environments where they must continually adapt to new tasks and evolving knowledge. Continual fine-tuning and in-context learning are costly and brittle, whereas neural memory methods promise lightweight updates with minimal forgetting. However, existing neural memory models typically assume a single fixed objective and homogeneous information streams, leaving users with no control over what the model remembers or ignores over time. To address this challenge, we propose a generalized neural memory system that performs flexible updates based on learning instructions specified in natural language. Our approach enables adaptive agents to learn selectively from heterogeneous information sources, supporting settings, such as healthcare and customer service, where fixed-objective memory updates are insufficient.

translated_title: 告诉我该学什么：将神经记忆泛化为可用自然语言控制的系统
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.23201v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：现代机器学习模型被部署在多样化、非平稳的环境中，必须持续适应新任务和不断演进的知识。持续微调和上下文学习成本高昂且脆弱，而神经记忆方法有望以最小遗忘实现轻量级更新。然而，现有的神经记忆模型通常假设单一固定目标和同质信息流，使用户无法控制模型随时间推移记住或忽略哪些内容。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一个广义的神经记忆系统，能够根据自然语言指定的学习指令执行灵活的更新。我们的方法使自适应智能体能够从异构信息源中进行选择性学习，支持诸如医疗保健和客户服务等固定目标记忆更新无法满足的应用场景。
tldr: 提出一种可用自然语言指令控制的广义神经记忆系统，使模型能够依据用户指令从异构信息源中选择性地学习，突破了传统神经记忆固定目标的局限。
